changed_reading.after: It stages security as a bounded center exposed against a ring of seizure, making the enclave's persistence itself the visible datum.
changed_reading.before: The ayah merely notes that one locality is safe while neighboring people face violence.

changed_reading.after: It turns the same امن root from granted security into misplaced heart-settlement: they experience a God-made secure condition yet entrust themselves to what cannot remain.
changed_reading.before: The ayah contrasts physical safety with an unrelated doctrinal error.

seeds.focus_anchor: `ءَامِنًا` and `يُؤْمِنُونَ` share ء م ن, while the latter takes `ٱلْبَٰطِلِ`.

changed_reading.after: Kufr is a perceptual act: it covers the visible gift and its maker even while the protected condition remains in view.
changed_reading.before: Kufr is only a refusal to say thanks for a benefit.

seeds.focus_anchor: `أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا أَنَّا جَعَلْنَا ... وَبِنِعْمَةِ ٱللَّهِ يَكْفُرُونَ`

changed_reading.after: They may already verbalize the correct maker; the failure is inferential and fiduciary, refusing to bind acknowledged causation to trust and gratitude.
changed_reading.before: They fail to notice who made the sanctuary.
